messages:
maya: Quick pulse — shipping milestone 2026-04 needs a decision today. We have three candidate cuts and one timeline squeeze. Can we align on MVP vs v1?
ton y: saw the doc, thanks. main constraint is infra capacity week-of-4/6 — if we shift two weeks we get a bigger window.
lina: what are the three candidate cuts? list please. :eyes:
maya: short list from PMing: 1) Tenant-level perm sync (complex edge cases) 2) Embedding cache warming UI 3) Admin bulk-impersonation tool. Also a smaller perf hook for latency diagnostics (low dev cost).
ben: my gut — push #1 to v1, keep the diag hook in MVP, and decide between #2/#3 based on risk. #2 is UX heavy, #3 backend heavy.
amanda: customer ask favors #3 (bulk impersonation) for pilot customers. But it's higher risk for auth audit surface.
maya: trade-off: pilot sign-ups vs security burden. If we keep #3 for MVP, we must constrain scope: read-only impersonation + audit log. That drops effort from ~3w -> ~1w. Thoughts?
lina: +1 on read-only with audit. If we do that we need a clear guardrail in the UI and SSO signal. I can spec the RBAC flag today.
ton y: operationally fine if we keep it gated behind a feature flag for beta tenants. Also need acceptance tests. @qa-bot can you add a checklist?
qa-bot: added checklist to thread and opened QA ticket QA-4287. Items: smoke, RBAC regression, audit-log integrity.
ben: about timeline — if we keep #3 scoped to read-only and defer #1 and #2 to v1, we can keep the milestone but move freeze by 7 days for extra test/pass cycles. Still on track for the customer demo on 4/20.
maya: 7 days seems acceptable. @release-bot can you update the milestone with a +7d freeze window and note the canary policy?
release-bot: milestone "2026-04-inference-milestone" updated: freeze window +7 days, canary rollout enabled (5% -> 25% -> 100%), fallback policy set to model-variant v0.9. :white_check_mark:
amanda: i'll draft the customer comms for the pilot changes and share before EOD.
lina: I'll drop the RBAC flag doc in Notion and link the acceptance criteria.
maya: ok, action items: @lina spec RBAC flag + acceptance today; @ben update timeline & deploy plan; @tony allocate infra capacity week-of-4/6; @amanda draft customer note; @lina/@ben/QA coordinate tests. We'll reconvene 10:30 PT. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
